a.lede: Binance has revealed more details about the cyber attack that resulted in the loss of $6.34 billion in digital assets.
a.title: Binance attackers used fake job interviews to pull off $6.3 billion crypto heist

b.lede: Suspected North Korean attackers duped an engineer with a fake job interview and a malicious download to gain a foothold in the crypto firm’s system and steal billions, according to Binance.
b.title: Binance Says Hackers Used Well-Known Tricks to Carry Out a $6.34 Billion Heist
